mapper.select: SELECT f.factory_id, f.enterprise_id, f.factory_code, f.factory_name, f.datasource_id, f.status, f.revision FROM mf_factory f JOIN mf_datasource d ON d.datasource_id = f.datasource_id WHERE f.status = 'ENABLED' AND d.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.factory_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN f.factory_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(f.factory_id AS DECIMAL(65, 0)) ELSE NULL END, f.factory_id LIMIT 1
